title: ext_01_database
description: Extension ext-01-database of the worked example: the datastore of the identity service and the tables that hold a password reset. A host writes a schema like this one beside the data file it describes (spec/extensions/); the toolkit finds it by its file name.

datastores.description: The datastores this extension describes. Each is a place where a component keeps its data.

items.description: One datastore: what it is called, which engine runs it and the component it belongs to.

datastore_id.description: Unique kebab-case id of the datastore. Format: ds-{name}. Example: 'ds-identity'.

name.description: The name of the datastore as the team says it.

description.description: What the datastore holds, in one or two sentences.

lifecycle.description: Lifecycle state of this datastore: active (default), deprecated or not_applicable.

aliases.description: Former ids of this datastore. Optional.

derives_from.description: Ids of the components (step 02) that own this datastore.

tables.description: The tables of the datastores. A table is something the system must have: it is planned, built and checked like a requirement.

items.description: One table: its name, its columns, the datastore it is part of and the requirement it exists for.

table_id.description: Unique kebab-case id of the table. Format: tbl-{name}. Example: 'tbl-reset-token'.

name.description: The table name in the database, snake_case.

description.description: What a row of the table is, in one or two sentences.

columns.description: The columns of the table, in the order of the table definition.

items.description: One column: its name, its type and whether it may be null.

type.description: The column type as the engine names it, for example 'uuid' or 'timestamptz'.

nullable.description: Whether the column may hold null. Default false.

term_ref.description: The glossary term this table stores, as a canonical ref (kind term). Each ref a table carries is listed in canonical_refs_used.

lifecycle.description: Lifecycle state of this table: active (default), deprecated or not_applicable.

scope.description: Delivery scope of this table: 'in' (the default), 'later' or 'out'. 'later' and 'out' require scope_reason.

scope_reason.description: Why this table is 'later' or 'out' of scope.

aliases.description: Former ids of this table. Optional.

derives_from.description: Ids of the functional requirements (step 04) this table exists for.

part_of.description: Id of the datastore of this extension that holds the table.

validation_rules.description: What a reviewer or a test checks about the tables, in prose. A rule names tables by their database name, not by id.

items.description: One rule: a short name and the check it asks for.

name.description: A short name of the rule.

check.description: What must hold, as one sentence that a test can verify.

allOf.description: Inherits shared step-base properties ($schema, id, owner, created_at, canonical_refs_used).
